home_title: A calmer desktop experience for Clash
home_lead: Clash Nyanpasu keeps daily proxy workflows focused and easy, with
home_platforms_lead: It follows system conventions and theme preferences while keeping the interface consistent across platforms.
home_docs_lead: Installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and development notes live in the docs.
home_positioning: A Clash desktop client, made for everyday use.
home_description: Profiles, rules, and traffic in one place. Free and open source for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
home_rebuild_description: A ground-up rewrite of the frontend and backend, with a cleaner interface and more capable tools.

home_dashboard_description: Arrange widgets to keep traffic, connections, and core status in view at a glance.
